rules: Apply defaults before test configuration overrides.
Use the configured database path for all connections.
Create its parent directory and schema on startup.
Preserve records across application instances.
Use parameterized SQL and close connections.
Tests use temporary databases.

expense.date: Required valid calendar date, exactly YYYY-MM-DD
expense.description: Optional string, at most 1000 characters; default empty
expense.amount_cents: Required integer from 1 through 100000000; reject booleans

query.category: Optional exact case-sensitive match after trimming; missing or empty means all categories

response.expenses: Matching expense objects, ordered by id ascending
response.total_cents: Integer sum of matching amounts, or 0

rules: Reject malformed JSON, non-object bodies, and unexpected fields.
Validate types before string operations.
Reject invalid dates and amount values.
Return JSON errors rather than HTML for invalid API input.
Invalid creates must not insert any record.
Use accessible labels and keyboard-operable controls.
Amount input accepts positive decimal dollars with at most 2 decimals.
Convert dollars to cents using validated decimal text, not float rounding.
Display money as CAD $12.34, with exactly two decimal places.
Category filter is a text input with an Apply Filter button.
An empty category filter shows all records.
Show date, category, description, and amount for each expense.
Refresh the full filtered list and total after adding an expense.
Display network and API errors visibly and preserve failed form input.
Render user content as text, never executable HTML.

verification: Empty list returns expenses=[] and total_cents=0.
Create an expense and verify every returned field and stored value.
Create multiple expenses and verify distinct IDs and ordering.
Amounts 10 and 20 cents total exactly 30 cents.
Filter by category and verify both matching records and total.
Unmatched category returns an empty list and zero total.
Reject malformed JSON, invalid dates, wrong types, and extra fields.
Reject zero, negative, fractional, boolean, and excessive cent amounts.
Reject empty or overlong categories and overlong descriptions.
Verify persistence using two app instances with the same database.
Browser: add two expenses and verify list and total.
Browser: filter expenses, then clear filter.
Browser: reload and verify saved expenses remain.
Browser: user HTML remains literal text.
Browser: simulate an API failure and verify visible error and retry.
